name: Motorcycle Simulator Wisconsin
summary:
Ride Milwaukee, Wisconsin, from the seat - alone or with your friends.

34 KM ROUND MILWAUKEE
Start in Bay View and head south on I-43 / I-94 to the Mitchell Interchange, west along the Airport Freeway past Mitchell airport, north up the Zoo Freeway through West Allis, then east on I-94 past State Fair Park and American Family Field into the Marquette - and back south high over the Menomonee valley past the Allen-Bradley clock, with Lake Michigan and the downtown towers on the horizon.

RIDE IT LIKE A REAL
